description:
The front plank is a great exercise that everyone knows, but getting it wrong can put unnecessary pressure on the lower back. It’s important not to do plank if you have poor form, so before you give it a try take a look at this and make sure you are getting it right. 

When doing a plan, make sure to get good core engagement, your hips level with shoulders and tilted forwards, and your eyes looking down.

Good form will get better results. Good luck!
